title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff + regional-failover thrashing
author: Priya Shah
description: Fixes a production issue where the SLO enforcer could enter rapid backoff/recovery cycles across regions causing repeated regional failovers and increased error rates. Root cause: timer jitter + aggressive immediate backoff combined with per-region decision logic that had no cross-region smoothing. This change introduces a coordinated backoff hysteresis (leader-based smoothing), a debounce window for per-instance enforcer state transitions, and a small randomized jitter cap to prevent synchronized retries. Also adds targeted unit and integration tests, several observability metrics and dashboards, and a canary rollout config. This PR is a hotfix: minimal surface changes with clear rollback path and monitored canary rollout.

release_notes: Stabilizes SLO enforcer backoff behavior across regions to prevent rapid regional failover thrashing. Adds cross-region smoothing, local debounce, jitter cap, tests, and dashboards. Deploy as canary then roll forward.
notes_for_oncall: Rollout should be monitored via slo_enforcer.backoff_state and leader_election.leader_changes metrics; if error rate increases, rollback to previous image and follow runbook docs/runbooks/slo-enforcer-failover.md
